item.title: Knife Attack Leaves Six Pro Kurdish Protestors Injured

item.title: Greek Airports Handled A Record 83 Million Passengers
item.description: Greek airports recorded a new passenger traffic record in 2025, handling a total of 83,333,571 passengers, up 4.9% from 79,424,082 passengers in 2024, according to statistics from the Hellenic Civil Aviation Authority (HCAA). The number of aircraft movements, including arrivals and departures for domestic and international flights, also increased. item.title: Greece 2026 Car Subsidy: Up to €30,000 for Electric Vehicles – Eligibility, Criteria & Details
item.description: Greece launches a major 2026 subsidy program offering up to €30,000 for new electric or low-emission vehicles under the Climate and Social Plan.
